ideas.pitch: An AI-powered local economic compliance and grant intelligence platform helping rural self-help groups and small enterprises navigate government welfare schemes.
ideas.title: PragatiAI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting real-world national socio-economic challenges directly aligns with the stated goal of CodeSlayer 2.0 to solve real-world problems for India, appealing heavily to a general panel of judges.

ideas.pitch: A supply chain carbon accounting tool utilizing automated document extraction to help regional MSMEs report scope 3 emissions accurately.
ideas.title: EcoTrace India
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high-priority climate reporting with practical engineering, mirroring the multi-agent automation that won at the GreenNovation Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A localized prescription interpretation and counter-fraud system protecting pharmacies and patients from forged or mistranscribed drug orders.
ideas.title: MedVerify AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on high-impact healthcare domain safety with a tightly scoped frontend and OCR pipeline executable within a 24-hour sprint.

ideas.pitch: An agricultural supply chain risk and price volatility prediction engine utilizing graph intelligence for regional farming cooperatives.
ideas.title: Agrisense Graph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses advanced graph intelligence and explainable features similar to the Bito platform that won the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous microgrid asset monitor and predictive maintenance scheduler for institutional college campuses in India.
ideas.title: CampusGrid
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate, relatable campus-level infrastructure problem that judges can physically see and verify during live evaluation rounds.
